key_reasoning.reason: Diffstat reports 8 files changed (257 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)), mapping to the L band by file count, though most of the volume is new/expanded test coverage rather than production logic: InputArray.tsx, DynamicFieldsForm.tsx and ToolForm.tsx are the only non-test files touched.

Primary change is to InputArray (adds required prop, persistent asterisk, aria-required on rows, and a hidden aria-required placeholder control for empty required lists), forwarded one layer up through DynamicFieldsForm. Bumped from S to M because InputArray is a shared/core form component consumed by multiple workflow-editor forms (ToolForm/ToolArgumentsForm, CustomNodeArgumentsForm), so the blast radius is wider than a single self-contained component edit.

Extends an already-established required-field pattern (asterisk + aria-required already used by Input, MultiSelect, ExpandableTextarea per DynamicFieldsForm.tsx) to InputArray's array-of-inputs shape. The only semi-novel piece is the hidden sr-only placeholder control used to expose aria-required when the required list is empty (no rendered items to attach it to); this is additive, easily reversible, and accessibility-only (no security/performance implications). ToolForm.tsx's existing Yup `required-fields` test (AC5) was verified by new tests rather than changed.
